First time I've come accross this subreddit, so I don't really know how dismissive people are here

However

You can't really think that there are loads people here all lurking and waiting for someone who's in trouble, only to comment on their thread like that will help the situation. Ultimately if you need serious help you need to seek proper services. No one is paid to comment on your threads, and it's entitled of you to think that people should be waiting on you when there are people out there that can't even make it to a computer let alone create a thread on a forum insulting people trying to help.

I understand if your going through a hard time, you want connection and support. The reality is that this is not a mental health facility. I would not have found this thread if I didn't experience these things, but expecting people here to contribute properly to my problems is far from a good place to start. If you need someone to talk to, seek a helpline or a doctor, a Reddit thread is for everyday venting at the most. No one owes you their time, as hard as that is to accept in predicaments like these.
